library(tidyverse)
library(dendextend)
library(here)
library(gplots)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(pheatmap)

# =========================================================================
# 1. Load Data & Prepare Dendrogram Object
# =========================================================================
load(here("Outputs", "photophys_preprocessed_data.RData"))
source(here("Scripts/00_visualization_prep.R"))

library(tidyverse)
library(dendextend)
library(here)

# =========================================================================
# 1. Run pheatmap quietly and capture its EXACT leaf order
# =========================================================================
# Ensure pheatmap is saved to an object 'ph'
ph <- pheatmap(
  heatmap_matrix_scaled,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = my_hclust, # Your pvclust / hclust object
  silent       = TRUE       # Suppresses plotting while extracting structure
)

# Extract the exact ordered vector of sample names as rendered by pheatmap
ordered_samples <- colnames(heatmap_matrix_scaled)[ph$tree_col$order]

# =========================================================================
# 2. Re-align Metadata Directly to the pheatmap Sequence
# =========================================================================
meta_aligned <- data.frame(SampleID_clean = ordered_samples) %>%
  left_join(meta_filteredK, by = "SampleID_clean") %>%
  mutate(
    Symbiont  = "Durusdinium trenchii",
    K_3_label = roman_map[as.character(K_3)]
  )

# Build metadata tracks using the strictly ordered metadata
color_host <- species_colors[as.character(meta_aligned$Species)]
color_sym  <- rep("#000000", nrow(meta_aligned))
color_k3   <- ann_colors$K_3[as.character(meta_aligned$K_3_label)]

annotation_tracks <- cbind(
  "Cluster"   = color_k3,
  "Host"      = color_host,
  "Symbiont"  = color_sym
)

# =========================================================================
# 3. Style the Dendrogram
# =========================================================================
# The pheatmap tree order is used above for metadata, so these tracks line up
# with the same left-to-right leaf order.
d_obj <- as.dendrogram(ph$tree_col)

# =========================================================================
# 4. Plot Annotated Dendrogram
# =========================================================================
plot_dir <- here("Plots")
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
pdf(file = here("Plots", "Aligned_Sample_Dendrogram.pdf"), width = 12, height = 3.5)

layout(matrix(c(1, 2), nrow = 2), heights = c(5, 1))

# Dendrogram and aligned annotation tracks
par(mar = c(0.5, 0.5, 1.5, 0.5))
plot(
  d_obj,
  horiz = FALSE,
  leaflab = "none",
  axes = FALSE,
  ylim = c(-0.8, max(attr(d_obj, "height"), na.rm = TRUE))
)

colored_bars(
  colors = annotation_tracks,
  dend = d_obj,
  horiz = FALSE,
  y_shift = -0.5,
  bar_width = 0.3
)
mtext("A", side = 3, adj = 0, line = 0.2, cex = 1.2)

# Compact legend row
par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0), xpd = NA)
plot.new()
plot.window(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")

host_order <- species_order
legend(
  x = 0.01, y = 0.65,
  legend = unname(species_labels[host_order]),
  fill = unname(species_colors[host_order]),
  title = "Host",
  horiz = TRUE, xjust = 0, yjust = 0.5, bty = "o", cex = 0.8
)
legend(
  x = 0.49, y = 0.65,
  legend = names(cluster_colors),
  fill = unname(cluster_colors),
  title = "Cluster",
  horiz = TRUE, xjust = 0, yjust = 0.5, bty = "o", cex = 0.8
)
legend(
  x = 0.79, y = 0.65,
  legend = "Durusdinium trenchii",
  fill = "#000000",
  title = "Symbiont",
  horiz = TRUE, xjust = 0, yjust = 0.5, bty = "o", cex = 0.8
)

dev.off()
